niche: Self-improvement, psychology and business lessons from books
visual_target: adult-facing cinematic stylized 2.5D/3D, expressive acting, realistic lived-in sets, warm rim lighting, deep dimensionality

character.hair: voluminous tousled curly dark-brown hair, natural sculpted texture
character.face: stylized appealing expressive proportions, prominent brows, brown expressive eyes
character.glasses: black rectangular frames consistently present across all camera angles
character.clothing: dark charcoal hoodie, visible hood and drawstrings
character.lighting: cinematic warm window key, cooler fill, warm highlights

shots.set: lived-in warm late-evening bedroom with smartphone alarm and unfinished plans
shots.camera: tight cinematic three-quarter to direct-to-camera, shallow depth
shots.action: eyes switch from phone to viewer; hand reaches toward phone; genuine eyelid/face animation
shots.narrative: Most people fail habits for one simple reason

shots.set: warm book-lined creative studio with depth and light practicals
shots.camera: medium close-up with book reveal and rack focus
shots.action: character physically picks up an original unbranded book prop and turns it toward the lens; factual title/author appear as separate clean overlays
shots.narrative: In Atomic Habits, James Clear explains that making a habit easier helps it stick

shots.set: desk/bedroom before-and-after showing behavior cue and easier first step
shots.camera: over-the-shoulder cut into action close-up, controlled motion
shots.action: character clears the desk and positions a notebook where it will be seen; visible environment change
shots.narrative: Make it obvious. Make it easy. Put the notebook where you'll use it.
